IC1: MDD Cohort: Meet DSM-5 criteria for Major Depressive Disorder [AND] by structured interview (MINI-KID); CDRS-R score >40; [NOT] Failure to achieve remission with at least 1 adequate prior antidepressant trial (e.g. SSRI [OR], SNRI [OR], or TCA), meaning at least 8 weeks at therapeutic dosing, including at least 4 weeks of stable dosing.
IC2: Anxiety Cohort: Meet DSM-5 criteria for any of the following anxiety disorders: Social Anxiety Disorders, [OR] Generalized Anxiety Disorder, [OR] Separation Anxiety Disorder  [OR]and/or Panic Disorder  [AND]by structured interview (MINI-KID); ADIS Clinical Severity Rating ≥4 (moderately severe) for any of the 4 included anxiety disorders; F[NOT] ailure to achieve remission with at least 1 adequate prior anxiolytic medication trial (e.g. SSRI, [OR] SNRI, [OR] or TCA), meaning at least 8 weeks at therapeutic dosing, including at least 4 weeks of stable dosing; F[NOT] ailure to achieve remission with previous CBT  [OR]or subject declines  [AND]current CBT therapy
IC3: Stable psychiatric medications and doses for the month prior to enrollment. Subjects may continue to engage in any ongoing psychotherapy.
IC4: Medically and neurologically healthy on the basis of physical examination and medical history.
IC5: Parents able to provide written informed consent and adolescents must additionally provide assent.
